steps.prompt_exact: Can you make a tiny window herb light planner as a single self-contained HTML file where I can enter a window direction, hours of direct sun, sill size, and a few herb choices, then it gives a visual layout and practical light/watering recommendations for a small apartment kitchen?
steps.response_exact:
Pick your window direction, plug in your sun hours and sill dimensions, check the herbs you want, and hit the button.

Pick your window direction, plug in your sun hours and sill dimensions, check the herbs you want, and hit the button. It'll show you a visual pot layout scaled to your actual sill width, flag any herbs that won't get enough light, and give per-herb watering cadences plus care tips. If you've got a north window or under 3 hours of sun, it'll also suggest the grow light workaround.
